headline: Houthi Strike Kills More Than 53 Recruits at Shabwa Camp
deck: Houthi ballistic missiles hit an internal-security training camp in Yemen’s Shabwa province, with authorities reporting more than 53 recruits killed.
body: Officials and military sources said Houthi ballistic missiles hit a military camp in energy-rich Shabwa province on Monday. Shabwa authorities said more than 53 recruits, all new members of the internal security forces undergoing training, were killed and more than 200 people were injured. [E2][E3]

Two military sources said three ballistic missiles struck Al-Alam camp. Local sources, speaking anonymously, said the Houthis launched the missiles at security forces during a training exercise. [E4][E6]
Dawn reported that fighting in Yemen was intensifying. [E5]
Rashad al-Alimi, president of Yemen’s UN-recognised government, said those killed on Monday were new recruits and vowed an immediate hard response. [E1]
On 6 October, this paper reported that Yemeni government forces had reported retaking Mokha during a counteroffensive against the Houthis. [E7]
